rules: Write clear, formal Brazilian Portuguese for a general-to-intermediate market reader.
Keep the source claim order unless a different order leaves every relationship explicit.
Use se for an unfulfilled condition; do not convert it to quando unless the source condition is fulfilled.
Use pode/poderá only when they match the source's non-certain modality; never use certamente to smooth prose.
Retain protected literals byte-for-byte in the localized article; presentation formatting is outside this pack.
Do not add causal connectors such as portanto or por isso merely to join sentences.
